info.name: MoneyReserve API
info.description:
Every route Budget Insights publishes, grouped by the release that introduced it (BI-31).

AUTHENTICATION. Every request sends Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}. Get a token from POST /api/auth/register or /api/auth/login, then POST /api/auth/verify (code 123456 on the local profile). Admin requests need a token for a number listed in moneyreserve.auth.super-admin-phones.

FLAGS. moneyreserve.insights.enabled is the master switch: with it off every route answers 404, as though the feature were not in the build. Each release has its own child flag, and with a child flag off its routes answer 501 — the tab is there and one capability inside it is withdrawn. 404 and 501 are different promises and clients should treat them differently.

OWNERSHIP. Another customer's row answers 404, never 403. A 403 would confirm the row exists, which is itself a disclosure.

item.name: R1 — Categories, manual transactions and the breakdown
item.description: Ships behind moneyreserve.insights.manual.enabled. With the flag off the three write routes answer 501 and every read here is untouched.

request.description: The ranked breakdown for a period. Omit from/to for the current month — that is the only shape the aggregate cache stores.
The expanded rows behind a category. Paginated with the platform's standard page/size.
The 17 seeded categories in display order, with their icon keys. Shared reference data — the same for every customer.
Masked tails only, four digits at most. Drives the All Accounts filter.
Manual entry. clientRef is the caller's idempotency key — replaying the same one returns the original row rather than creating a second.
Partial update. Re-categorising writes an audit row and raises CATEGORY_OVERRIDDEN.
Soft delete. The row keeps its audit trail and stops counting towards every aggregate.

item.name: R2 — Monthly budget and the summary ring

request.description: The ring: spend against target, utilisation, pace and the days text. Answers with budgetSet=false rather than an error when no target is set.
The target and any per-category limits for a period.
Upsert. alertThresholdPct defaults to the configured value (80) when omitted.

item.name: R3 — Consent and data rights
item.description: Behind moneyreserve.insights.consent.enabled. Consent governs reading bank messages and nothing else: every other route works without it.

request.description: consentVersion must equal the version currently in force, or the grant is refused with INSIGHTS_CONSENT_VERSION_MISMATCH. Consent to superseded text is not consent.
The latest consent row. consentGiven=false for a customer who never granted or has withdrawn.
Writes a new row rather than updating. Takes effect on the next ingest call with no deploy.
Returns 202 with an exportId and the path to fetch it. The export expires — expiresAt says when — and erasure takes it with everything else.
The document itself, as raw JSON outside the usual envelope. 404 if it is not yours, 410 once it has expired.
Irreversible. Clears every table this service holds for the customer and reports the per-table counts. bi_compliance_event is not cleared — it has no user_id, so it holds no row that is yours.

item.name: R4 — SMS ingest and reference sync
item.description: Behind moneyreserve.insights.ingest.enabled, and behind consent. Carries Compliance gate 2.

request.description: Parsed fields only — the contract has no free-text field, so there is no way for message content to arrive. OtpGuard re-checks every field server-side and rejects the batch with 422 on a hit.

The sender allowlist and parser templates a handset needs. Consent-gated: 403 INSIGHTS_CONSENT_REQUIRED without it.

SMS format discovery: an app that sends vocabularyVersion (its cached vocabulary version, 0 if none) also receives `vocabulary` {version, words[{id, word}]} when the server's is newer and Phase 2 is on. Apps that do not send it get exactly today's response.
Seven days, two series (card and bank), always both — a series emptied by the account filter is still returned so the chart does not change shape.

item.name: R6 — Alerts and recommendations
item.description: Behind moneyreserve.insights.alerts.enabled and .recommendations.enabled, which roll back independently.

request.description: Threshold crossings raised for the period containing the date, newest first. In-app only — nothing here sends SMS, push or email.
Sets a timestamp that is never unset. Acknowledging twice does not move it.

50/30/20 against the customer's monthly target, never their income — this service never sees income. Per-category caps come from the trailing three COMPLETE months, so the current partial month is deliberately invisible here.

Reports that the handset's own filter detected an OTP or PIN and destroyed the message. There is no field here capable of carrying the message, the code or the sender — only that a detection happened, of which kind, and when. The server fixes source=SMS_PARSER and action=DISCARDED; a client cannot assert either, nor any of the other seven event types. clientRef is hashed before storage and makes a retry the same incident rather than a second one.

item.name: SMS format discovery (Phases 1-3)
item.description: Learning bank SMS formats that no template reads, without receiving any message. The phone keeps an unreadable SMS encrypted for up to 60 days and sends only counts (Phase 1) and the message's shape (Phase 2). A format reaches the admin only once 5 or more customers have sent it; a template made from it is synced to every phone, which then re-reads its waiting messages through ordinary ingest.

request.description: Daily counts of money SMS from a bank sender that no template could read, per day. Counts only: there is no field for a message. Each item is a finished day's total and replaces any earlier value from this device for that day and sender. Days older than 7 days, counts outside 1..500 and senders that look like phone numbers are rejected per item. 501 while format-discovery.enabled is off or the device-hash salt is missing; 403 without current consent.

The shape of an SMS no template could read: vocabulary word ids with their case (4c = Payment), W for unknown words, typed placeholders with their format (AMT:c2, ACCT:NNNNXXXXNNNN, DATE:dd/MM/yy, TIME:hh:mm a, N:6), punctuation, NL; a leading ~ means no space before. Never text, digits or names (SkeletonGrammar). One result per sample: ACCEPTED, DUPLICATE (this user already counted for that format) or REJECTED with MR.FMT.E.003/004. 501 while format-discovery.samples-enabled is off or the user-hash key is missing; 403 without current consent; 429 above the daily limit.

Phase 1 report: per sender, money SMS no template could read over the last `days` days (1..90, default 30), the number of devices, the last day seen, whether the sender is on the allowlist and how many live templates its bank has. Counts only.

Phase 2: formats sent by at least 5 different customers (the floor cannot be configured lower; it is applied in the query). status OPEN (default) / RESOLVED / REJECTED, optional senderId, page, size (max 100). coveredByTemplateId names a live template that already reads an open format.
One format. 404 for an unknown id and for a format below the 5-customer floor alike.

item.name: F6 Start a template from a format (admin)

request.description: Phase 3: builds a sample SMS from the format with invented values (Sample Text, 1,234.56, 05/03/26 ...) and returns it with the template wizard's own analysis, exactly as if it had been pasted. The dashboard opens the existing wizard with both; generate, save and publish as usual. bankCode must be a bank in the bank list (add the bank first for a new bank). Nothing is saved here. Rate-limited with the builder.
Marks an open format as not one to template. reason: NOT_TRANSACTION, PROMOTION, DUPLICATE or OTHER. Recorded with the admin and the time.
The words a phone may name in a skeleton, by permanent id, with source and whether still active. Ids are never reused.

item.name: Budget Insights admin (Super Admin only)
item.description: The admin dashboard's API: Overview and Configuration. Every route needs X-User-Roles to contain SUPER_ADMIN (403 MR.ADM.E.001 otherwise). The admin API is always on wherever Budget Insights is enabled (no admin.enabled switch). moneyreserve.insights.admin.config-write-enabled=false answers 403 MR.ADM.E.004 on every write while reads keep working. Configuration writes are drafts: nothing reaches handsets or the categoriser until POST /config/publish.

request.description: Screen 01. KPIs, transactions per day by source, category and bank distribution, reference versions on handsets. Counts only. from/to default to the last 30 days (max 366, not in the future: 400 MR.ADM.E.005). A panel whose query failed is null and named in panelErrors.
Tab counters, the current reference release and the pending-changes bar (pendingChanges, changesetRevision). Counts are of items that exist after publish.
Banks the admin can configure (moneyreserve.insights.admin.banks).
Icon keys the mobile app ships; a category must use one of them.
Screen 02. Effective view: published values with any pending change applied. state is PUBLISHED or DRAFT_*; OTHER is locked. usage = transactions30d, transactionsTotal, merchantRules, budgetLimits.

header.description: Required on every configuration write: the changesetRevision the dashboard last saw. Absent, * or a mismatch answers 409 MR.ADM.E.010.

Active banks by default (dropdowns); ?active=all for the management list. Each item carries usage{senders, activeSenders, templates, activeTemplates, customerAccounts, deletable, deactivatable}.
Immediately available in every bank dropdown. bankCode = 4-digit CBSL code, fixed after creation. 409 E.008 duplicate code/name.

item.name: B2 — Rename / turn bank on or off

request.description: Saved as a DRAFT for a live bank (state DRAFT_EDITED / DRAFT_DEACTIVATED; live values in `published`) and applied with the next publish; kept in release history and restorable. A bank still pending with its first sender draft changes directly. 409 E.023 when turning off a bank that active senders/templates use. If-Match optional; the response carries changesetRevision.
Saved as a DRAFT for a live bank (state DRAFT_DELETED until publish). Only for banks nothing ever used (409 E.023 otherwise). If-Match optional; data.changesetRevision returned.

header.description: Optional. The changesetRevision the dashboard last saw; a mismatch answers 409 MR.ADM.E.010.

request.description: Send newBank {bankCode (4-digit CBSL), bankName} instead of bankCode to add the bank together with the sender draft. The bank is pending until publish and removed if the draft is discarded. 409 E.008 if the code or name exists (pick it via bankCode instead).

item.name: BP1 — Budget policy (live, draft, last published)

request.description: Configuration › Budget Policy. 50/30/20 split, recommendation period, default category alert threshold, pace tolerance, and which budget alert types are raised. published = live, effective = after the next publish.

item.name: M1 — Message types (wizard list, active only)

request.description: Message types SMS templates pick from. ?active=all for the management list (with usage counts), ?active=false for turned-off types.

Applies immediately. code is UPPER_SNAKE and never changes; 409 MR.ADM.E.008 when it exists. logicalType: ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION, CARD_PURCHASE, ATM_WITHDRAWAL, CASH_DEPOSIT, TRANSFER, PAYMENT, CHEQUE, LOAN, BANK_CHARGE_OR_REFUND, REFUND_OR_REVERSAL.

item.name: M3 — Change message type / turn on or off

request.description: Replaces every field except code. fixedCategoryCode null = merchant rules decide. Turning a type off only stops new templates from picking it.
